name: Chloe Faleena
source:
"Ah, um, I'm Chloe Faleena... It's a weird name, right? Faleena... If you look up the meaning... it bums me out! That aside, please take care of Chloe Aaron--er, I mean Celica!"

One of the Ludens hastily created by [url=/c160583]ARATA[/url]. She was formed using data of the character Celica Clayton, a certain someone's memories, and the body of Raffy Candy—Chloe's manager who died of illness.

Because of the data, she looks a lot like Celica, but since she loved Celica Clayton to begin with, she's totally happy about it. Even after returning from death, she wishes to continue serving as [url=/c160593]Chloe's[/url] manager, and ARATA assigns her a special mission.

She was originally a passionate Celica fan and a gamer. She played World's Odyssey long before it became popular. Her obsession manifests in bizarre, almost superhuman skills. Although she didn't serve as Chloe's manager for long in life, their trust ran deep. Who would've thought she'd continue being a manager after death?! Later in the story, [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] will come face-to-face with Faleena's despair.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category6&ch=falena]official website[/url]]
